_comment: Manifest of workshop team submissions. Add one entry per CSV file you place in this folder, then open a pull request. The dashboard reads this file to know what to load.
_howToAdd: Copy the example object, set file/team/city/date, and delete nothing else. Validate with: python3 scripts/validate_submission.py data/submissions/<your-file>.csv

submissions.note: Worked example so the loader has something to read on a fresh clone. Delete or ignore once real submissions arrive.
